title: SG-1 · Remove worker module and execution backend
summary: Delete backend/worker, backend/internal/execution and its server wiring so the remaining backend compiles without them.
description: Context: Worldseed is a game and contribution project, not a development platform. The separate Go module backend/worker (with its own go.mod) and the package backend/internal/execution (imported by backend/internal/server/server.go) are development automation. Desired behavior: both are deleted, nothing under backend/ imports them, and the remaining packages (contribution, round, player, world, admin, gitrepo, safepath) still compile. Why: devion project workseed owns development automation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo after the change, when backend/worker is looked up, then the directory and its go.mod do not exist.
Given the repo after the change, when backend/internal/execution is looked up, then the directory does not exist.
Given the remaining backend packages, when they are built and tested, then they compile and pass, and no Go file under backend/ imports the worker module or internal/execution.

in_scope: Remove execution wiring and execution admin routes from backend/internal/server
out_of_scope: Frontend ExecutionPanel and admin UI removal
Config key cleanup beyond what compiles
preserve: backend/internal/contribution, round, player, world, admin, gitrepo, safepath

technical_constraints: Go module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/backend must keep building with go build ./...
